description: Backend project with API endpoints, services, and data access

shall: All public APIs must have explicit type annotations
Input validation must use a schema library (zod/joi/class-validator)
All async functions must handle errors explicitly
Database queries must use parameterized queries or ORM
Rate limiting must be implemented on public endpoints
All endpoints must return consistent error response format
Integration tests required for critical API paths
shall_not: Do not expose internal stack traces to clients
Do not use any type without documented reason
Do not swallow errors silently (empty catch blocks)
Do not bypass schema validation for any user input
